children: Los Angeles fashion brand implements Centric PLM to further enhance product development information and workflows.

CAMPBELL, Calif., Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Centric Software® announces that STAUD has gone live with Centric PLM. Centric Software delivers innovative, integrated, end-to-end AI-powered enterprise solutions to take products from concept to commercialization. Fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home, consumer electronics, food & beverage, cosmetics and personal care as well as multi-category retail teams plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, assort, sell and replenish products to achieve strategic and operational digital transformation goals.

Founded in Los Angeles in 2015, STAUD is a Los Angeles-based fashion brand offering handbags, ready-to-wear and accessories. STAUD implemented Centric PLM to drive product development information and workflows.

Centric PLM is now live at STAUD and is being used to organize product-related information in a centralized digital environment. The implementation is intended to further enhance STAUD's product development process by centralizing product data and related information for use by internal teams and manufacturing partners.
"We are pleased that STAUD is now live with Centric PLM to manage its product development information and workflows," says Fabrice Canonge, CEO of Centric Software.

Founded in Los Angeles in 2015 by Sarah Staudinger and George Augusto, STAUD was born out of a desire to create a fashion collection that is both accessible and innovative. The brand focuses on high-quality design and sophisticated silhouettes that bridge the gap between vintage charm and modern sensibility.

From its headquarters in Silicon Valley, Centric Software provides an innovative and AI-enabled product concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. As experts in fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home, food & beverage, cosmetics & personal care, consumer electronics as well as multi-category retail, Centric Software delivers best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products.
